dossiers.originalTitle: Fibra Inn anuncia resultados del tercer trimestre 2026 — Operación Hotelera Por Operador
dossiers.evidenceSnippet: FINN 3T26 results (ES): Por Operador — Fibra Inn 29 hotels / 5,007 rooms; Aimbridge Latam 2 hotels / 424 rooms (7.8% rooms; 28.9% NOI) as of 2026-09-30. Portfolio annex lists The Westin Monterrey Operando 174 rooms. Informe ASG 2025 table: The Westin Monterrey Valle — Copropiedad — Bajo acuerdo de gestión — 174 rooms (only luxury co-owned hotels still under gestión alongside JW Marriott 250; 174+250=424). Operator attribution to Aimbridge is corroborated by matching the only two non-internalized hotels to the Aimbridge room count. HMA expiration / notice windows NOT disclosed. Governance policy: upon expiration of remaining third-party HMAs, hotels fold into Servicios Hoteleros FINN — competing MCT window is constrained. Do not treat completed 28-hotel internalization as open MCT.

dossiers.hotelName: Fairfield Inn & Suites Villahermosa / InHouse Villahermosa
dossiers.originalTitle: BMV eventfid_1574632 — Transición del hotel en Villahermosa a arrendamiento bajo la marca InHouse
dossiers.evidenceSnippet: FIHO Q2 2026 BMV PDF (ES): El hotel de Servicio Limitado Villahermosa terminó su contrato de operación y franquicia el 1 de julio de 2026 e iniciará operaciones bajo un esquema de arrendamiento con la marca InHouse. HR Ratings 2026: transición bajo marca InHouse; 134 habitaciones; Fideicomiso cede la operación. RECONCILIATION: prior structure = MANAGEMENT + FRANCHISE (Marriott/Fairfield) terminated; successor = LEASE (arrendamiento) with InHouse brand — not an HMA replacement. Do not conflate lease termination with management replacement. Track B V3 already stored lease start 2026-07-01; this finding locks the dual-instrument classification.
